Hi, I’m Christa Ingabire. I’m am currently pursuing a Master's in Data Science at the University of British Columbia. Before starting graduate school, I worked as a data engineer
at the Rwanda Social Security Board, in Kigali, Rwanda, where I built and maintained data pipelines supporting national social protection programs. Previously, I worked in software and data consulting in Minneapolis, Minnesota, U.S.A.

My interests sit at the intersection of data engineering, statistical learning, machine learning, and applied data science, particularly when the underlying data represents people, institutions, or public systems.
